tracks.title: 四番の下駄箱
tracks.genre: Japanese forró pop (accordion, zabumba and triangle, upbeat danceable)
tracks.subject: a young regular at a neighbourhood sento who always draws shoe-locker number four (shi, 'death'), teased for it until the grandmother at the counter says four is the shi of shiawase (happiness), and the old regular who once hogged it swaps lockers to give it back
